posts.title: One URL Can Expose Cloud Credentials
bullets: Inventory URL fetchers: webhooks, link previews, image imports and document converters.
Allowlist outbound destinations, validate resolved IP addresses at connection time and disable unsafe redirects.
Block access to internal networks and cloud metadata; on AWS, require IMDSv2 as defense in depth.
posts.takeaway: Test DNS rebinding, redirects and metadata access.
posts.caption:
SSRF turns a URL-fetching feature into a path toward internal services or cloud metadata. Inventory webhooks and URL previews, restrict outbound destinations, validate resolved IPs at connection time, and disable unsafe redirects. On AWS, enforce IMDSv2 as defense in depth.
